questions.q: In una zona a traffico limitato non possono entrare più di un certo numero di veicoli
questions.proper: In a limited traffic zone, no more than a certain number of vehicles may enter.
questions.rule: False. A ZTL restricts access according to rules such as vehicle category, authorization or time. It is not defined by a fixed maximum number of vehicles that may enter.
questions.ling: The key structure is possono entrare: potere + infinitive means “can enter.” Più di means “more than.” The trap is the idea of un certo numero - a fixed number - which is not what zona a traffico limitato means.

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato indica un'area di parcheggio riservato ai veicoli della Polizia di Stato
questions.proper: The sign shown indicates a parking area reserved for State Police vehicles.
questions.rule: False. The blue P sign indicates authorized parking. A reservation for a particular category, such as police vehicles, would need additional information on a supplementary panel.
questions.ling: Raffigurato is a past participle used like an adjective: “the sign shown.” Riservato a means “reserved for.” In ai veicoli, ai = a + i. Notice that the sentence adds a very specific restriction that the basic P sign does not contain.

questions.q: Se un infortunato della strada è cosciente, ma ha avuto un trauma della gabbia toracica, con ferita visibile e profonda, bisogna comprimere subito con un panno pulito
questions.proper: If a road casualty is conscious but has suffered chest trauma with a visible, deep wound, it is necessary to press it immediately with a clean cloth.
questions.rule: True in the ministerial quiz. The first-aid rule is to protect and compress the visible wound with a clean cloth while waiting for professional medical help, without attempting advanced medical treatment.
questions.ling: Se introduces a condition: “if.” Ha avuto is the passato prossimo of avere: “has had / suffered.” Bisogna + infinitive is an impersonal way to say “it is necessary to...” or “one must...”.

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato è posto in corrispondenza di un percorso pedonale accanto ad un percorso per le biciclette, separati da spartitraffico
questions.proper: The sign shown is placed at a pedestrian path next to a bicycle path, separated by a traffic divider.
questions.rule: False. This sign indicates a shared pedestrian-and-cycle path. It does not describe two separate paths divided by a traffic island or separator.
questions.ling: In corrispondenza di is a high-value Patente expression meaning “at the exact location of.” Accanto a means “next to.” Separati is plural because it refers to the two paths described in the sentence.

questions.q: Il pannello integrativo raffigurato è posto su strade innevate per segnalare la presenza di macchine sgombraneve
questions.proper: The supplementary panel shown is placed on snow-covered roads to warn of snowploughs.
questions.rule: True. The panel warns of snowplough vehicles operating on snowy roads. Drivers must approach with extra caution and keep an appropriate distance from the working vehicle.
questions.ling: È posto is a passive construction: “is placed.” Per + infinitive expresses purpose: per segnalare = “in order to warn.” Innevate agrees with the feminine plural noun strade.

questions.q: La distanza di sicurezza è commisurata anche al numero di corsie della strada
questions.proper: The safety distance is also determined according to the number of lanes on the road.
questions.rule: False. Safety distance depends on factors such as speed, reaction ability, road grip, tyres, traffic and weather. The number of lanes is not a factor used to determine it.
questions.ling: Commisurare a means “to base or adjust according to.” Here al = a + il. The word anche means “also” and tries to add the number of lanes to the genuine list of factors.

questions.q: Quando si traina un rimorchio, la pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici del veicolo trainante deve essere la stessa degli pneumatici del rimorchio
questions.proper: When towing a trailer, the tyre pressure of the towing vehicle must be the same as the tyre pressure of the trailer.
questions.rule: False. The towing vehicle and trailer each use the pressure specified for their own tyres and loading conditions. Their pressures do not have to be identical.
questions.ling: Quando si traina uses an impersonal si: “when one tows / when towing.” Deve essere means “must be.” La stessa is feminine because it agrees with pressione.

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato si può trovare all'inizio di una strada urbana o extraurbana che gode del diritto di precedenza
questions.proper: The sign shown can be found at the beginning of an urban or extra-urban road that has priority.
questions.rule: True. The yellow diamond identifies a priority road and can be placed at the beginning of an urban or extra-urban road that has priority at intersections.
questions.ling: Si può trovare literally looks like “one can find itself,” but naturally means “can be found.” Che introduces a relative clause. Godere del diritto di precedenza means “to have the right of way.”

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato può essere posto nelle vicinanze di un campo da gioco frequentato da bambini
questions.proper: The sign shown may be placed near a playground frequented by children.
questions.rule: True. The children warning sign is used near places where children are likely to be present or cross the road, such as schools and playgrounds.
questions.ling: Può essere posto is modal + passive: “may be placed.” Nelle vicinanze di means “near / in the vicinity of.” Frequentato da uses da to introduce who frequents the place.

questions.q: È regolamentare trovare sulla pavimentazione la scritta P L, con croce di S. Andrea, per segnalare un passaggio a livello
questions.proper: The letters P L together with a St Andrew's cross may be marked on the road surface to indicate a level crossing.
questions.rule: True. P L and the St Andrew's cross are recognized road markings used to warn of a level crossing.
questions.ling: È regolamentare + infinitive means that something is permitted or compliant with the rules. Scritta here is a noun meaning “inscription.” Passaggio a livello is a fixed expression meaning “level crossing.”

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato indica una limitazione di transito su un tratto di strada per i veicoli di massa effettiva superiore a 7 tonnellate
questions.proper: The sign shown indicates a traffic restriction on a section of road for vehicles whose actual mass exceeds 7 tonnes.
questions.rule: True. The temporary sign directs or restricts traffic for vehicles whose actual mass is over 7 tonnes. The key quantity is actual mass, not merely the vehicle's theoretical maximum mass.
questions.ling: Superiore a means “greater than.” Massa effettiva means the vehicle's actual mass at that moment. Su un tratto di strada means “on a section of road.”

questions.q: Se il carico sporge longitudinalmente per l'intera larghezza della parte posteriore del veicolo, si devono applicare due pannelli retroriflettenti in figura
questions.proper: If the load projects rearwards across the full width of the vehicle, two retroreflective panels of the type shown must be fitted.
questions.rule: False. The panel shown identifies certain heavy trailers/semitrailers. A rear-projecting load must instead be marked with the red-and-white striped projecting-load panel; two are used when the projection extends across the full rear width.
questions.ling: Se introduces the condition. Si devono applicare is an impersonal/passive form: “must be fitted.” L'intera larghezza means “the entire width.” The trap is not the grammar; it is that the pictured panel is the wrong panel.

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato ricorda di spegnere il motore in caso di arresto prolungato in galleria
questions.proper: The sign shown reminds drivers to switch off the engine in the event of a prolonged stop in a tunnel.
questions.rule: True. In a prolonged traffic stop inside a tunnel, switching off the engine reduces exhaust emissions and unnecessary fuel use while the vehicle is stationary.
questions.ling: Ricordare di + infinitive means “to remind [someone] to...” Here: ricorda di spegnere. In caso di means “in the event of.” Arresto here is a traffic-imposed stop, not normal parking.

questions.q: Se il tram o il filobus sono fermi la manovra di sorpasso può effettuarsi a destra se esiste il salvagente
questions.proper: If a tram or trolleybus is stopped, it may be overtaken on the right if there is a passenger refuge.
questions.rule: True. The passenger refuge separates and protects boarding/alighting passengers, allowing the vehicle to be passed on the right when the other road conditions permit it.
questions.ling: Può effettuarsi means “can be carried out”; the final -si gives a passive/impersonal meaning. Salvagente literally can mean “life-saving device,” but in road language it means a pedestrian/passenger refuge island.

questions.q: Il fenomeno dell'aquaplaning rafforza il contatto fra pneumatici e asfalto
questions.proper: Aquaplaning strengthens the contact between the tyres and the road surface.
questions.rule: False. Aquaplaning occurs when a layer of water reduces or removes direct tyre-road contact. Grip falls and the vehicle becomes harder to steer and brake.
questions.ling: Rafforzare means “to strengthen.” That single verb reverses the real effect and makes the sentence false. Fra ... e ... means “between ... and ...”.

questions.q: La luce gialla fissa si accende quando è ancora accesa quella rossa
questions.proper: The steady yellow light comes on while the red light is still on.
questions.rule: False. In the normal traffic-light sequence, steady yellow follows green and precedes red. Yellow is not shown while the red light is still illuminated.
questions.ling: Si accende means “turns on / lights up.” Quella rossa uses quella to avoid repeating luce: “the red one.” Ancora means “still” and is the key timing word.

questions.q: Il segnale raffigurato vieta la sosta nei periodi in cui viene effettuata la pulizia meccanica della strada
questions.proper: The sign shown prohibits parking during the periods when mechanical street cleaning is carried out.
questions.rule: True. The supplementary information limits the no-parking rule to the indicated street-cleaning days and hours.
questions.ling: Nei periodi in cui means “during the periods in which.” Viene effettuata is a passive construction: “is carried out.” Remember that sosta means parking, not every brief stop.

questions.q: Nell'incrocio rappresentato nella figura il conducente del veicolo A passa per ultimo
questions.proper: In the intersection shown, the driver of vehicle A passes last.
questions.rule: False. In this diagram L passes first; A and C can then pass together; D passes last. Vehicle A is therefore not the last vehicle.
questions.ling: Passare per primo / per ultimo is the standard Patente wording for “go first / go last.” Nell' is in + l'. Rappresentato is another past participle used as an adjective: “shown in the figure.”

questions.q: La sosta è vietata dovunque venga impedito lo spostamento di veicoli in sosta
questions.proper: Parking is prohibited wherever it prevents parked vehicles from being moved.
questions.rule: True. You may not park in a way that blocks another correctly parked vehicle from entering, leaving or being moved.
questions.ling: Dovunque means “wherever.” After this indefinite expression, the sentence uses the subjunctive passive venga impedito = “is prevented.” Veicoli in sosta simply means parked vehicles.

questions.q: Le cinture di sicurezza hanno lo scopo di mantenere il corpo attaccato al sedile in caso di urto violento
questions.proper: Seat belts are intended to keep the body against the seat in a violent impact.
questions.rule: True. Seat belts restrain the occupant during a collision, reducing contact with the vehicle interior and the risk of being thrown from the vehicle.
questions.ling: Avere lo scopo di + infinitive means “to have the purpose of...” Al = a + il. In caso di means “in the event of.” This is a common way the quiz explains the function of a safety device.

questions.q: Prima di iniziare a guidare un autoveicolo è opportuno regolare gli specchi retrovisori interni ed esterni
questions.proper: Before driving a motor vehicle, it is advisable to adjust the interior and exterior rear-view mirrors.
questions.rule: True. Mirrors should be adjusted before moving off so that the driver has the best possible view behind and beside the vehicle.
questions.ling: Prima di + infinitive means “before doing...” È opportuno + infinitive is an impersonal recommendation: “it is advisable to...” Ed is a form of e often used before a following vowel.

questions.q: La patente di categoria A2 può essere conseguita da chi ha almeno 18 anni di età
questions.proper: An A2 licence may be obtained by anyone who is at least 18 years old.
questions.rule: True. The minimum age for obtaining category A2 is 18 years.
questions.ling: Può essere conseguita is modal + passive: “may be obtained.” Chi means “whoever / the person who.” Almeno is an important numerical word meaning “at least.”

questions.q: Una frenatura poco efficiente o squilibrata può essere causata dal consumo eccessivo delle guarnizioni frenanti
questions.proper: Inefficient or unbalanced braking can be caused by excessive wear of the brake linings.
questions.rule: True. Excessively worn brake linings reduce braking efficiency and can contribute to unequal braking force between wheels.
questions.ling: Poco efficiente means “not very efficient,” not “a little efficient.” Può essere causata da is the standard passive cause structure. Dal = da + il.

questions.q: L'uso del climatizzatore comporta minor consumo di carburante
questions.proper: Using the air conditioner results in lower fuel consumption.
questions.rule: False. Air conditioning requires energy from the vehicle and generally increases fuel or energy consumption rather than reducing it.
questions.ling: Comportare means “to entail / result in.” Minor consumo means “lower consumption.” This is a classic reversal: replacing maggiore with minor changes the truth of the statement.

questions.q: Attraversare un passaggio a livello con manovra azzardata per guadagnare tempo, può essere un pericolo per molti individui, oltre che per il conducente
questions.proper: Crossing a level crossing recklessly to save time can endanger many people, not just the driver.
questions.rule: True. A dangerous level-crossing manoeuvre can put the driver, passengers, other road users and people on the train at risk.
questions.ling: The infinitive Attraversare acts as the subject of the sentence: “Crossing...” Per + infinitive expresses purpose: per guadagnare tempo. Oltre che means “as well as / in addition to.”

questions.q: La responsabilità civile connessa al sinistro stradale consiste nell'obbligo di risarcire i danni causati sia alle persone che alle cose
questions.proper: Civil liability arising from a road accident consists of the obligation to compensate damage caused to both people and property.
questions.rule: True. Civil liability concerns compensation for damage caused to persons and property as a result of the accident.
questions.ling: Consistere in means “to consist of.” Risarcire i danni means “to compensate damages.” The paired construction sia ... che ... means “both ... and ...”.

questions.q: Il simbolo raffigurato è posto sul comando di accensione dei proiettori di profondità
questions.proper: The symbol shown is on the control for switching on the high-beam headlights.
questions.rule: True. This is the symbol for the high-beam headlights (proiettori di profondità); the corresponding dashboard warning light is blue.
questions.ling: Essere posto su means “to be located on.” Comando di accensione means the switch/control used to turn something on. Proiettori di profondità is the formal Patente term for high beams.

questions.q: Dopo aver effettuato una manovra di sorpasso il conducente del veicolo deve riportarsi a destra appena possibile senza creare pericolo o intralcio
questions.proper: After overtaking, the driver must return to the right as soon as possible without creating danger or obstruction.
questions.rule: True. Once an overtaking manoeuvre is completed, the driver must return to the right when it can be done safely and without obstructing other traffic.
questions.ling: Dopo aver + past participle means “after having done...” Riportarsi a destra means “move back to the right.” Senza + infinitive means “without doing...”.

questions.q: L'assunzione di alcool facilita la guida, perché rende più vigili e attenti
questions.proper: Drinking alcohol makes driving easier because it makes you more alert and attentive.
questions.rule: False. Alcohol impairs attention, judgement and reaction time and can create overconfidence. It does not make the driver more alert or attentive.
questions.ling: Rendere + adjective means “to make [someone] ...”: rende più vigili = “makes more alert.” Perché introduces the reason. The whole sentence is built as a cause-and-effect reversal.

questions.q: La svolta a destra si effettua senza mai dare la precedenza ai pedoni, se il semaforo ha la luce verde accesa
questions.proper: A right turn is made without ever giving way to pedestrians if the traffic light is green.
questions.rule: False. A green light permits the vehicle to proceed, but a driver turning right must still give way to pedestrians who are crossing as required.
questions.ling: Si effettua is an impersonal/passive form: “is carried out.” Senza mai + infinitive is a strong absolute: “without ever doing...” This kind of absolute wording is a frequent Patente trap. Dare la precedenza a = “give way to.”
